tithi.name: Purnima
tithi.description: Sharad Purnima, celebrated for the nectar-showering rays of the Moon, promoting vitality, peace, and spiritual illumination.

panchang.festival_or_vrat: Sharad Purnima (Kojagiri Purnima / Maharishi Valmiki Jayanti)

Mesha.summary: The Moon residing in your sign brings clarity, renewed vigor, and magnetic personal appeal.
Mesha.general: Your natural leadership qualities take center stage today. Trust your intuition when resolving long-standing personal matters.
Mesha.career: Collaborative endeavors yield fruitful results as colleagues willingly rally behind your vision. Keep your communications crisp and transparent.
Mesha.finance: Favorable planetary currents support thoughtful self-investments and long-term planning. Avoid impulsive festive splurges.
Mesha.relationships: Your warmth and attentiveness will melt away recent misunderstandings with loved ones. An evening walk or quiet conversation deepens bonds.
Mesha.health: High energy levels sustain you throughout the day. Channel restlessness through calming pranayama or light stretching.
Mesha.remedy: Offer arghya (water) mixed with red sandalwood and raw milk to the Full Moon tonight.

Vrishabha.summary: A restful day centered on introspection, spiritual restoration, and mindful expenditure.
Vrishabha.general: The 12th house Moon prompts you to step back from the hustle and seek solace. A quiet day spent recalibrating your priorities will serve you best.
Vrishabha.career: Avoid initiating high-stakes professional showdowns today. Work quietly behind the scenes to streamline unfinished paperwork.
Vrishabha.finance: Unexpected philanthropic or household expenses could arise. Maintain a balanced budget to keep peace of mind intact.
Vrishabha.relationships: Give partners and family members ample breathing room today. Compassionate silence will heal friction far better than debates.
Vrishabha.health: Prioritize quality sleep and limit screen exposure before bedtime. Soothing chamomile tea or warm milk will induce deep rest.
Vrishabha.remedy: Light a pure cow ghee lamp under a Tulsi plant in the evening.

Mithuna.summary: Vibrant social connections and unexpected gains highlight a very rewarding Sunday.
Mithuna.general: The Moon activating your 11th house brings celebration, uplifting camaraderie, and hopeful aspirations. Networking today opens promising doors for the coming week.
Mithuna.career: Team brainstorming leads to innovative breakthroughs that impress senior peers. Your intellectual agility is at its peak.
Mithuna.finance: Past investments or freelance projects may yield delightful returns today. Financial optimism is justified, but maintain disciplined saving habits.
Mithuna.relationships: Gatherings with close friends and elder siblings bring joy and mutual validation. Romantic conversations are lighthearted and sincere.
Mithuna.health: Vitality is robust and spirits are high. Nourish your body with wholesome, freshly prepared autumnal meals.
Mithuna.remedy: Chant the Vishnu Sahasranama or recite 'Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya' 108 times.

Karka.summary: Professional prestige and family honor receive a profound cosmic uplift today.
Karka.general: With your sign lord transiting the 10th house, your actions reflect dignity, competence, and clarity. Step forward confidently into any leadership duties.
Karka.career: Supervisors and mentors notice your dedication and conscientious approach. Organizing your strategy today sets a successful tone for upcoming projects.
Karka.finance: Stability prevails in your economic sphere, enabling long-range security planning. Favorable for decisions regarding real estate or business capital.
Karka.relationships: Balancing professional thoughts with family time will win heartfelt appreciation at home. An elder’s blessings will bring mental peace.
Karka.health: Watch your posture and take short breaks if working on digital devices. Physical stamina remains steady.
Karka.remedy: Prepare kheer (rice pudding), expose it to the Full Moon rays, and share it as Prasad.

Simha.summary: Fortunate planetary alignments awaken optimism, philosophical depth, and serendipity.
Simha.general: The Moon moving through your 9th house expands your horizons and brings auspicious fortune. A visit to a sacred space or engaging in sacred study is highly favored.
Simha.career: Mentorship, publishing, and creative collaborations receive powerful cosmic backing. Ideas conceived today carry significant long-range potential.
Simha.finance: Favorable indications for investments connected with higher education, long-distance trade, or family trust funds. Spend wisely on worthy causes.
Simha.relationships: Mutual respect and uplifting dialogue strengthen your connection with your spouse. Long-distance relatives may bring heartwarming tidings.
Simha.health: Outdoor walks in fresh morning air will revitalize both mind and body. Guard against digestive heaviness from rich foods.
Simha.remedy: Offer water mixed with jaggery and kumkum to Surya Dev during the morning hours.

Kanya.summary: Deepen your inner balance through mindful discernment and patience with emotional shifts.
Kanya.general: The 8th house Moon calls for quiet emotional contemplation rather than hasty external commitments. Trust that behind-the-scenes transitions are working for your eventual growth.
Kanya.career: Avoid taking uncalculated risks or rushing collaborative projects today. Focus on deep research, auditing, and refining hidden details.
Kanya.finance: Review joint finances, insurance matters, or family commitments with meticulous care. Refrain from lending money on impulse.
Kanya.relationships: Honest, compassionate vulnerability will strengthen intimate partnerships. Steer clear of unhelpful suspicions or over-analysis.
Kanya.health: Practice mindfulness to release underlying tension in the neck and shoulders. Keep your meals simple, light, and hydrating.
Kanya.remedy: Chant the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra 11 times for peace and protection.

Tula.summary: Harmonious partnerships and heartwarming social engagements make this Sunday glow.
Tula.general: With the Full Moon directly illuminating your relationship sector, your charm and diplomatic skill reach full blossom. Meaningful agreements thrive under this influence.
Tula.career: Consulting and public-facing engagements receive great reception today. Your ability to create consensus will resolve any lingering team friction.
Tula.finance: Joint ventures and shared economic decisions gain traction. Discuss mutual financial plans with your partner openly.
Tula.relationships: A beautifully romantic day where shared laughter and heartfelt appreciation take the spotlight. Single natives might experience a captivating introduction.
Tula.health: Balance your hydration and enjoy leisure activities that soothe your nervous system. Gentle yoga is recommended.
Tula.remedy: Offer white fragrant flowers (such as jasmine) to Goddess Lakshmi in the evening.

Vrischika.summary: Productive momentum and disciplined organization bring a satisfying sense of accomplishment.
Vrischika.general: The 6th house transit of the Moon gives you the resilience and analytical precision needed to clear accumulated chores. Systematize your schedule for the upcoming week.
Vrischika.career: Tackle intricate tasks that demand meticulous attention to detail. Your pragmatic solutions will quickly resolve minor workplace hurdles.
Vrischika.finance: A good day to balance checkbooks, track recurring subscriptions, and settle small debts. Prudence today guarantees freedom tomorrow.
Vrischika.relationships: Express care through thoughtful acts of service rather than complex discussions. Mutual support in daily duties brings warmth to domestic life.
Vrischika.health: Pay attention to your gut health and avoid overly spicy or heavy foods. A brisk evening walk will boost your metabolism.
Vrischika.remedy: Feed fresh green fodder or jaggery to a cow or recite the Hanuman Chalisa.

Dhanu.summary: Creative inspiration, joyful leisure, and affectionate warmth enrich your day.
Dhanu.general: With the Moon activating your 5th trine house, artistic flair and intuitive wisdom flourish effortlessly. Dedicate time to hobbies, children, or self-expression.
Dhanu.career: Original ideas formulated today have immense market viability. Express your unconventional strategies with conviction and cheerfulness.
Dhanu.finance: Speculative ventures should still be vetted with prudence, though good fortune smiles on creative monetizations. A small treat for family is well spent.
Dhanu.relationships: Romance sparkles with spontaneous humor and playful affection. Joyful moments with children or creative friends lift your heart.
Dhanu.health: Vibrant vitality keeps you in high spirits throughout the day. Engaging in outdoor sports or dance will feel wonderfully invigorating.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a subtle tilak of yellow chandan (sandalwood) on your forehead after your morning bath.

Makara.summary: Domestic tranquility and inner contentment blossom as you focus on family harmony.
Makara.general: The Moon in your 4th house invites you to nest, recharge your emotional batteries, and beautify your living space. Cherish peaceful moments at home.
Makara.career: Reflect on work-life harmony and plan your foundational strategy for next week. Avoid bringing occupational stress into your sanctuary.
Makara.finance: Favorable day for home decor investments or reviewing family property matters. Ensure every major expense is aligned with long-term utility.
Makara.relationships: Deep and healing conversations with your mother or maternal figures strengthen family roots. Create an atmosphere of security and mutual affection.
Makara.health: Emotional relaxation will directly soothe physical tiredness. Savor warm herbal teas and practice slow, conscious breathing.
Makara.remedy: Seek the heartfelt blessings of your mother or an elder matriarch in the family.

Kumbha.summary: Clear communication, purposeful initiatives, and joyful local outings energize you.
Kumbha.general: The 3rd house Moon enhances your courage, curiosity, and communicative charisma. Short trips, lively exchanges, and new learning adventures are favored.
Kumbha.career: Writing, pitching concepts, and closing communication loops will proceed seamlessly. Your proactive initiative inspires colleagues to step up.
Kumbha.finance: Modest commercial ventures or marketing endeavors show promising indicators. Expenses related to technology or travel yield good value.
Kumbha.relationships: Warm camaraderie with siblings, cousins, and neighbors brightens your afternoon. An honest conversation brings two close friends even closer.
Kumbha.health: Shoulders, arms, and respiratory vitality are strong. Channel your excess energy into a refreshing workout or creative hobby.
Kumbha.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 24 times facing the morning sun.

Meena.summary: Financial discernment, gracious speech, and delightful family meals crown your day.
Meena.general: The Moon's presence in your 2nd house accentuates domestic prosperity, eloquent speech, and emotional stability. Speak with kindness, and doors will open effortlessly.
Meena.career: Solidify upcoming business negotiations by articulating value clearly. Your measured, confident tone earns respect from partners.
Meena.finance: Promising trends for savings, wealth consolidation, and family asset growth. Avoid impulse shopping by keeping a firm shopping list.
Meena.relationships: Gathering around wholesome food with family members brings laughter and warmth. Sweet-spoken words heal any past domestic tension.
Meena.health: Pay attention to vocal hygiene and keep yourself hydrated with warm water. Gentle walks after meals will aid smooth digestion.
Meena.remedy: Offer raw milk, batasha (sugar sweets), and white flowers to the Full Moon at night.

tithi.name: Pratipada
tithi.description: Fosters grounded initiation, inner purification, and settling into contemplative routines following the full moon.

panchang.festival_or_vrat: Kartika Krishna Pratipada / Kartika Snan Arambha

Mesha.summary: High vitality and clarity empower you to command respect and initiate vital tasks.
Mesha.general: The Moon traversing your ascendant heightens intuitive perception and confidence. You can channel this vibrant mental surge into meaningful creative leadership.
Mesha.career: Take proactive charge of ongoing presentations and collaborative discussions. Your ideas will resonate strongly with seniors and peer associates.
Mesha.finance: Personal investments into skill refinement or tools will pay dividends. Avoid impulsive luxury buys despite buoyant spirits.
Mesha.relationships: Your warm presence revitalizes marital and romantic bonds. Be patient and receptive when listening to your partner's emotional needs.
Mesha.health: Vitality is elevated, making it a great day for aerobic movement. Keep adequately hydrated to avoid mild heat-related restlessness.
Mesha.remedy: Offer clean water mixed with raw milk and white sesame seeds to a Shiva Lingam.

Vrishabha.summary: Restful contemplation and selective boundary-setting will protect your mental tranquility.
Vrishabha.general: With the 12th house Moon, you may feel an urge to withdraw from loud settings. Conserve your energy and prioritize reflective planning over bold assertions.
Vrishabha.career: Handle administrative backlogs quietly rather than pitching unvetted ventures. Foreign interactions or remote research projects yield valuable insights.
Vrishabha.finance: Unplanned household or health expenses might arise; keep a contingency budget handy. Resist lending capital on verbal assurances.
Vrishabha.relationships: Minor misunderstandings can brew if you remain overly distant. Communicate with gentleness and clarity to reassure your loved ones.
Vrishabha.health: Eye strain or erratic sleep cycles require attention. Disconnect from digital screens an hour before sleeping.
Vrishabha.remedy: Chant the Chandra Beej Mantra 'Om Shram Shreem Shroum Sah Chandraya Namah' 11 times in the evening.

Mithuna.summary: Lucrative networking opportunities and uplifting camaraderie brighten your professional outlook.
Mithuna.general: Transit through the 11th house activates substantial social and financial gains. Collaborative initiatives started today carry long-term momentum.
Mithuna.career: Your strategic inputs will impress team leaders and yield collective milestones. Excellent progress is indicated for those in media, marketing, and technology.
Mithuna.finance: Past investments or pending payments are likely to materialize smoothly. Consider redirecting surplus funds into structured savings.
Mithuna.relationships: Social gatherings bring memorable moments with friends and family. A romantic bond deepens through shared future aspirations.
Mithuna.health: Energy levels remain stable and upbeat throughout the day. Light evening walks will help ease minor ankle or calf stiffness.
Mithuna.remedy: Feed green fodder or spinach to a cow during morning hours.

Karka.summary: Professional accomplishments take center stage, unlocking meaningful recognition from authorities.
Karka.general: With your sign ruler gracing the 10th house, your dedication commands genuine respect. Step forward boldly to assume responsibility and showcase managerial precision.
Karka.career: Supervisors appreciate your methodical problem-solving and calm demeanor under deadlines. It is an auspicious window for scheduling pivotal client negotiations.
Karka.finance: Professional gains and performance bonuses appear promising. Exercise prudence when committing to long-term commercial leases.
Karka.relationships: Work commitments may compress personal time, but thoughtful check-ins maintain harmony. Share your achievements with your family to uplift the domestic vibe.
Karka.health: Maintain correct posture during extended desk work to avert joint fatigue. Balance intense concentration with deep breathing pauses.
Karka.remedy: Apply a gentle tilak of white sandalwood paste on your forehead after morning bath.

Simha.summary: Fortunate coincidences and expansive philosophical clarity guide your decisions today.
Simha.general: The 9th house Moon unlocks auspicious serendipity, ethical conviction, and mental expansiveness. Trust your refined instincts when charting new academic or travel plans.
Simha.career: Mentors and senior advisors offer pivotal guidance that reframes your trajectory. Long-distance communications or advisory roles proceed with remarkable ease.
Simha.finance: Financial fortunes lean favorably toward educational or legacy assets. Avoid speculative gambling; lean into principled value generation.
Simha.relationships: Spiritual or cultural discussions with elders cultivate profound domestic peace. Couples experience rekindled optimism through mutual respect.
Simha.health: Overall vitality is strong, though hip or thigh flexibility exercises are recommended. Fresh, satvik meals will sustain your inner vigor.
Simha.remedy: Offer Arghya (water) mixed with a pinch of red kumkum to the rising Sun.

Kanya.summary: Patience and analytical prudence will transform minor obstacles into constructive breakthroughs.
Kanya.general: The Moon traversing the transformative 8th house calls for calculated poise. Avoid unnecessary friction and concentrate on solving deep-rooted structural issues.
Kanya.career: Review contract clauses and fine print thoroughly before affixing signatures. Work steadily behind the scenes rather than seeking immediate public validation.
Kanya.finance: Keep tight surveillance on shared assets, taxes, and insurance filings. Avoid lending money or taking unexpected loans today.
Kanya.relationships: Guarded feelings can trigger unvoiced tensions with your partner. Transparent dialogue dissolves lingering insecurities effectively.
Kanya.health: Pay attention to digestive sensitivity and avoid excessively spicy dishes. Gentle yoga and meditation will quiet any underlying restlessness.
Kanya.remedy: Recite the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra 11 times to invoke protective blessings.

Tula.summary: Collaborative harmony and public diplomacy bring remarkable synergy to personal and business fronts.
Tula.general: The 7th house Moon emphasizes interpersonal harmony, balance, and cooperative achievements. Your natural diplomacy bridges gaps and produces mutually rewarding agreements.
Tula.career: Partnership ventures receive a major boost through coordinated teamwork. Business clients are highly receptive to your courteous and transparent terms.
Tula.finance: Joint ventures and shared commercial channels show promising cash inflow. Allocate a portion of gains toward liquid emergency reserves.
Tula.relationships: Romantic ties blossom with mutual admiration and quality companionship. Unmarried natives may encounter meaningful marriage proposals or alignment.
Tula.health: Maintain optimal kidney and urinary wellness by drinking plenty of water. Mild evening stretching relieves lower-back tension.
Tula.remedy: Donate white sweetmeats or rice kheer to young girls or women in need.

Vrischika.summary: Diligent discipline and keen problem-solving enable you to conquer competitive hurdles.
Vrischika.general: The 6th house transit of the Moon bolsters your stamina, diligence, and tactical mastery. You will effortlessly outmaneuver bureaucratic delays and petty detractors.
Vrischika.career: Task execution runs like clockwork thanks to your systematic prioritization. A favorable day for resolving workplace conflicts and streamlining workflows.
Vrischika.finance: Debt servicing and pending liabilities can be settled effectively today. Avoid impulse purchases during online sales.
Vrischika.relationships: Keep critical tendencies in check when talking to family members. Empathy and constructive encouragement will preserve domestic warmth.
Vrischika.health: Guard against minor seasonal allergies or acidity. Integrate probiotic foods into your diet and maintain structured sleep hours.
Vrischika.remedy: Chant the Hanuman Chalisa in the morning to strengthen your resolve and vitality.

Dhanu.summary: Creative inspiration and emotional warmth ignite meaningful joy and intellectual fulfillment.
Dhanu.general: With the Moon activating your 5th house of intellect and Purva Punya, your inventive spirit shines. Your intuitive insights yield elegant solutions to complex puzzles.
Dhanu.career: Brainstorming and artistic pursuits gain tremendous traction. Students and researchers will experience remarkable retention and conceptual clarity.
Dhanu.finance: Calculated, researched investments look promising, but avoid impulsive speculation. Monetizing a creative skill starts showing viable promise.
Dhanu.relationships: Romantic charm and mutual understanding are at an all-time high. Meaningful conversations with children or younger kin bring profound joy.
Dhanu.health: Energy levels are spirited and cheerful. Mindful breathing practices will help sustain your mental focus throughout demanding hours.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a saffron or turmeric tilak on your forehead and offer yellow flowers to Lord Vishnu.

Makara.summary: Focusing on domestic serenity and emotional grounding restores your inner equilibrium.
Makara.general: The 4th house Moon draws your attention toward home life, emotional reassurance, and core foundations. Balancing professional ambition with domestic demands is key today.
Makara.career: Prioritize internal team coordination over aggressive external expansions. Real estate, construction, and educational domains experience productive stability.
Makara.finance: Expenses regarding home improvements or parental comfort may surface naturally. Ensure property paperwork and vehicle insurances are up to date.
Makara.relationships: Spending dedicated time with your mother or matriarchal figures brings blessings. Open-hearted warmth dissolves lingering family frictions.
Makara.health: Take preventive measures against chest congestion or seasonal coughs. Warm herbal infusions like tulsi-ginger tea will fortify your wellness.
Makara.remedy: Touch the feet of your mother or elders to seek their sacred blessings before starting your day.

Kumbha.summary: Decisive courage, active communication, and brief journeys yield productive outcomes.
Kumbha.general: The Moon in your 3rd house stimulates entrepreneurial courage, initiative, and swift communication. Express your viewpoints boldly as your voice carries significant weight.
Kumbha.career: Short business travel and client outreach will unlock constructive doors. Publishing, writing, sales, and digital projects thrive under this vibrant influence.
Kumbha.finance: Modest short-term gains through diversified commission or freelance channels are favored. Avoid speculative spending on gadgets you do not immediately need.
Kumbha.relationships: Harmonious interactions with siblings and neighbors uplift your spirits. An engaging evening conversation brings laughter and shared understanding with your partner.
Kumbha.health: Shoulder and upper-arm stretches will relieve localized tension. Maintain a brisk pace during outdoor morning workouts.
Kumbha.remedy: Feed birds with soaked grains on your terrace or balcony in the morning.

Meena.summary: Financial consolidation and eloquent articulation support material and family prosperity.
Meena.general: The 2nd house transit of the Moon amplifies your speech, financial wisdom, and domestic ties. Speak with warmth, as your words can heal rifts and negotiate favorable outcomes.
Meena.career: Financial appraisals, resource planning, and accounting reviews progress effortlessly. Your ability to persuade stakeholders will gain substantial managerial support.
Meena.finance: Savings accumulate steadily through structured fiscal discipline. A promising day for setting up automated mutual fund deposits or fixed assets.
Meena.relationships: A joyful gathering or hearty shared meal with family fosters mutual bonding. Your considerate gestures reassure your partner of your unwavering devotion.
Meena.health: Protect your throat and vocal cords from excessive cold beverages. Nutritious, home-cooked food will optimize digestion and vitality.
Meena.remedy: Place a silver coin or square piece in your wallet and offer raw milk to a Peepal tree.
